title: Serve on any address with a certificate for the configured server name
spec: Add a network path beside the loopback-only lab path, changing no existing signature. Listener::bind_network binds any local address, including every interface, while Listener::bind keeps refusing non-loopback addresses. LabServer::bind_network and LabRuntime::bind_network use it, and the runtime signs the TLS server certificate for a ServerName instead of localhost. ServerName accepts a lowercase-normalised DNS name (labels of 1 to 63 letters, digits or inner hyphens, at most 253 characters, no trailing dot, a last label that is not all digits) or an IP literal (IPv6 with or without brackets, IPv4-mapped IPv6 as IPv4), and refuses wildcards, Unicode, ports, and unspecified, multicast and broadcast addresses. The peer's IP is read from the TCP socket before admission and exposed as BootstrapStream::peer_ip. The enrollment handler counts its per-source limit against source_key(peer): an IPv4 address on its own, an IPv6 address by its /64. A client pinned to the configured name completes enrollment and sign-in; a client expecting another name refuses the server; a client without a device certificate gets no application bytes.
